verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable this period, but the local storefront and Google profile are quietly underperforming.
diagnosis: Return on ad spend sits near 5x on $6,150 spend, strong for food & beverage, but zero calls or direction requests signal local demand leakage.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend near 5x
signals.detail: This period generated $30,739 in tracked purchase value against $6,150 spend. Healthy for a subscription meat brand.

signals.headline: 663 purchases from Instagram ads
signals.detail: Image creative for Premium Cuts drove consistent sales. Add-to-cart volume of 711 shows the funnel is converting cleanly.

signals.headline: Zero calls or direction requests
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove no calls and no direction clicks this period. Local intent is not converting to foot traffic.

signals.headline: 276 reviews, 5-star latest rating
signals.detail: Review volume and quality are strong assets. The profile is working for trust but not for action.

signals.headline: 1,900 new follows this period
signals.detail: Organic Instagram added followers steadily. Engagement rate on posts remains thin at 37 average interactions.

recommendations.title: Fix the Google Business Profile call-to-action
recommendations.detail: Zero calls and direction requests this period is a leak. Consider adding a prominent order link, phone button, and a weekly local post tied to delivery radius.

recommendations.title: Test a gifting angle before Thanksgiving
recommendations.detail: Return on spend near 5x suggests room to scale. Worth testing a holiday gift-box creative against Premium Cuts to capture the Q4 gifting window.

recommendations.title: Lean harder on local and halal provenance
recommendations.detail: National competitors source abroad. Test creative that names the Illinois farm, the Hoffman Estates butcher, and the Zabiha halal certification against the big brands.
